_about: The comic (dialogue poster) library: the cartoon styles and the cartoon series, read by the page (web/src/lib/comic.js) and by the worker (backend/semasa/comic_library.py), so both name the same styles and the same cast. A style's `prompt` and `lettering` go into the picture maker's prompt VERBATIM every time: that is how a style is remembered and how a different picture maker draws the same look. A character's `look` is repeated word for word in every episode. Wan's own styles and series live in the settings row `comic` ({styles, series}) and are merged over these by id: the same id replaces, a new id is added.

about.bm: Warna rata, lorekan lembut, garis hitam tebal, palet hangat. Gaya contoh 16 Nov.
about.en: Flat colour, soft shading, bold black outlines, a warm palette. The look of the 16 Nov sample.

styles.prompt: Clean modern comic illustration. LINE: bold black outlines of one even weight around every figure and object, thinner black lines for the details inside them; closed, smooth lines, nothing sketchy or broken. COLOUR: flat fills in a warm, friendly palette of cream and soft beige walls, warm skin tones, dusty pink, mustard yellow and navy blue, at medium saturation. SHADING: one soft, slightly darker tone of the same colour under chins, hair and cloth folds; no hatching, no gradients, no hard black shadows. PROPORTIONS: semi-realistic adults about six heads tall, shown from the waist or the chest up. FACES: simple and expressive: oval eyes with a black pupil and one white highlight, thin eyebrows, a small simple nose, clear open or closed mouth shapes. BACKGROUND: the setting simplified into flat, muted shapes with few details, lighter and less saturated than the characters. FINISH: crisp digital artwork with no paper texture and no grain.
styles.lettering: Speech bubbles are smooth white ovals with an even black outline and a small curved tail. The lettering is a rounded, upright, bold sans-serif in black, in sentence case, centred in its bubble.

about.bm: Kartun akhbar harian: garis dakwat longgar, hidung besar, warna pudar dua tiga tona.
about.en: A daily newspaper cartoon: loose ink line, big noses, two or three faded tones.

styles.prompt: Classic daily newspaper comic strip. LINE: loose, lively black ink line that goes thick and thin as if drawn with a dip pen, with a few short hatching strokes for shadow. COLOUR: a limited faded palette printed on off-white newsprint: pale yellow, dull light blue and a soft brick red only, each used as a flat tint, with large areas left as plain off-white paper. SHADING: hatching and small solid black areas only; no soft shading and no gradients. PROPORTIONS: cartoon adults about four heads tall with large heads, big rounded noses, small bodies and four-fingered hands. FACES: dot eyes or small ovals, eyebrows that float above the head, wide simple mouths, strongly exaggerated expressions. BACKGROUND: almost empty: a ground line, one or two objects sketched in outline, the rest plain paper. FINISH: slightly rough ink edges and a faint newsprint paper tone.
styles.lettering: Speech bubbles are hand-drawn, slightly uneven white balloons with a thin black ink outline and a pointed tail. The lettering is hand-written comic capitals in black ink, upright and evenly spaced.

about.bm: Hitam putih sepenuhnya, tona titik kelabu, mata besar, garis laju.
about.en: Pure black and white with grey dot tone, large eyes, speed lines.

styles.prompt: Black and white Japanese manga page. LINE: fine, precise black pen lines of varying weight, thicker on the outer contour of a figure and hair-thin for details. COLOUR: none at all: pure black ink on pure white paper, with grey made only by regular dot screentone. SHADING: flat dot screentone in two densities on hair, clothes and cast shadows, plus solid black areas for dark hair; no soft grey, no gradients. PROPORTIONS: slim figures about six and a half heads tall with slightly long legs and small hands. FACES: large, tall eyes with detailed irises and two white highlights, a tiny nose drawn as one short line, a small mouth, sharp chins, hair drawn in pointed locks. BACKGROUND: clean technical line drawing of the setting in thin lines, or plain white with a few straight speed lines behind a speaker for emphasis. FINISH: crisp black and white print with visible dot pattern and no colour anywhere.
styles.lettering: Speech bubbles are clean white ovals with a thin black outline and a short straight tail. The lettering is a neat, upright, black sans-serif in sentence case, centred, with generous white space around it.

about.bm: Kepala besar, badan kecil, warna pastel, pipi merah jambu.
about.en: Big heads, tiny bodies, pastel colours, pink cheeks.

styles.prompt: Cute chibi cartoon. LINE: soft, rounded dark brown outlines of one medium weight, with no sharp corners anywhere. COLOUR: bright pastel palette of mint green, baby pink, butter yellow, sky blue and lilac on a very pale cream background, flat fills. SHADING: almost none: one lighter spot of shine on hair and a small pink oval of blush on each cheek; no cast shadows. PROPORTIONS: super-deformed characters exactly two heads tall: a very large round head, a small rounded body, short stubby arms and legs, mitten hands without separate fingers. FACES: very large round shiny eyes set low on the face with two white highlights each, no nose, a tiny curved mouth, simple big expressions. BACKGROUND: one flat pastel colour with a few small simple shapes that suggest the setting, such as a shelf, a table or a window; no detail. FINISH: smooth, clean, sticker-like digital artwork.
styles.lettering: Speech bubbles are rounded white cloud-like shapes with a soft dark brown outline and a short rounded tail. The lettering is a rounded, friendly, bold sans-serif in dark brown, in sentence case, centred.

about.bm: Komik lama 1960-an: titik halftone, merah kuning biru terang, bayang hitam pekat.
about.en: A 1960s comic book: halftone dots, loud red, yellow and blue, solid black shadows.

styles.prompt: Retro 1960s pop comic book printing. LINE: heavy, confident black brush outlines that swell and taper, with solid black shapes for deep shadow and hair. COLOUR: only the four old printing colours: bright red, bright yellow, bright cyan blue and black, on slightly yellowed white paper; skin is drawn as a field of small pink dots. SHADING: visible halftone dots of even size in regular rows for every mid tone, and flat solid black for shadows; no soft shading, no gradients. PROPORTIONS: realistic, dramatic adults about seven heads tall, shown in close-up from the shoulders or the chest. FACES: realistically drawn with strong jaws, full lips, arched eyebrows and dramatic, wide-eyed expressions. BACKGROUND: a flat block of one bright colour or a field of halftone dots, with the setting suggested by one or two bold outlined objects. FINISH: slightly misaligned colour plates and a rough printed paper feel.
styles.lettering: Speech bubbles are white with a bold black outline and a sharp pointed tail. The lettering is bold, upright, hand-drawn comic-book capitals in black, tightly spaced and centred.

about.bm: Lukisan buku cerita: cat air lutsinar, garis pensel nipis, tepi kabur, warna tanah.
about.en: A storybook painting: transparent watercolour, a thin pencil line, soft edges, earthy colours.

styles.prompt: Soft watercolour storybook illustration. LINE: thin, light, slightly wobbly grey-brown pencil line that fades in places; no black outline. COLOUR: transparent watercolour washes in a muted earthy palette of sage green, terracotta, ochre, dusty rose and soft grey-blue, with the white of the paper left showing through for the lightest areas. SHADING: a second, wetter layer of the same colour that pools darker at the edges of a shape; soft blooms and uneven washes; no flat fills and no hard shadows. PROPORTIONS: gentle, slightly simplified adults about five and a half heads tall with soft rounded shoulders. FACES: small dot or short-dash eyes, a faint line for the nose, a small soft mouth, a light wash of pink on the cheeks, calm and kind expressions. BACKGROUND: loose, pale washes that suggest the setting with a few painted shapes, fading out to bare paper towards the edges of each panel. FINISH: visible cold-pressed watercolour paper texture and soft, feathered edges everywhere.
styles.lettering: Speech bubbles are soft-edged shapes of bare off-white paper with a thin grey-brown pencil outline and a small tail. The lettering is neat, upright, rounded handwriting in dark grey-brown, in sentence case, centred.

about.bm: Bentuk geometri tanpa garis luar, palet terhad, gaya ilustrasi korporat moden.
about.en: Geometric shapes with no outlines, a limited palette, the modern editorial look.

styles.prompt: Flat vector illustration with no outlines. LINE: none: every form is a solid geometric shape with clean, sharp edges; no contour lines anywhere. COLOUR: a strict limited palette of five flat colours: deep teal, warm coral, sand yellow, off-white and charcoal, each used as a solid fill, with skin in one flat warm tone. SHADING: none except one slightly darker flat shape for a shadow side, cut with a straight or evenly curved edge; no gradients, no texture. PROPORTIONS: stylised adults about five heads tall built from simple shapes: rounded rectangle bodies, long simple limbs, small hands drawn as plain rounded shapes. FACES: minimal: two small charcoal dots for eyes, no nose or one small curve, a simple short curved line for the mouth; expression shown mostly by posture and eyebrows. BACKGROUND: a single flat colour from the palette with two or three large simple shapes for furniture, shelves or windows. FINISH: perfectly smooth, even vector artwork with no grain.
styles.lettering: Speech bubbles are flat off-white rounded rectangles with no outline and a small triangular tail. The lettering is a clean, geometric, medium-weight sans-serif in charcoal, in sentence case, centred.

about.bm: Komik Eropah klasik: garis nipis sekata, warna rata tanpa bayang, latar terperinci.
about.en: The classic European album: an even thin line, flat colour with no shadows, detailed backgrounds.

styles.prompt: Classic European clear-line comic album. LINE: thin black outlines of exactly the same weight everywhere, on figures and backgrounds alike; every shape fully closed; no hatching and no line variation. COLOUR: flat, even, cheerful colours of medium brightness: brick red, sky blue, leaf green, sand and warm grey, with no black fills. SHADING: none at all: no shadows on faces or clothes, no gradients, no highlights; every area is one flat colour. PROPORTIONS: neat, slightly simplified adults about five and a half heads tall in clear, readable poses shown from the knees up. FACES: very simple: small dot eyes, thin short eyebrows, a small rounded nose, a simple line mouth, tidy hair drawn as one shape. BACKGROUND: carefully drawn, realistic and detailed setting in the same thin line and flat colour, with correct perspective and many small accurate objects. FINISH: clean printed album page, sharp and bright, with no texture.
styles.lettering: Speech bubbles are white rectangles with slightly rounded corners, a thin black outline and a small pointed tail. The lettering is small, neat, upright hand-lettered capitals in black, evenly spaced.

series.name: Kak Lin Tanya

about.bm: Pengasas produk PKS bertanya, perunding regulatori menjawab. Sesuai untuk kosmetik, halal dan makanan.
about.en: A small-business founder asks, a regulatory consultant answers. Suits cosmetics, halal and food.

series.setting: a small product workshop and office in Malaysia: a wooden worktable with plain unlabelled jars, pouches and boxes on it, a low shelf behind the two people, a plain light wall above the shelf

A.name: Kak Lin
A.look: a Malaysian Malay woman in her late thirties with a round, friendly face, wearing a mustard-yellow tudung pinned neatly under the chin, a teal long-sleeved blouse and a small brown crossbody bag
A.role: pengasas produk PKS (kosmetik dan makanan) yang mahu buat betul tetapi keliru dengan peraturan
A.voice: santai dan terus terang, bertanya seperti orang biasa bertanya, ayat pendek, guna 'saya' dan partikel harian seperti 'ke', 'kan', 'eh'

B.name: Encik Adam
B.look: a Malaysian Malay man in his early forties with short neat black hair and thin rectangular glasses, wearing a light grey long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and dark navy trousers, holding a slim tablet with a blank dark screen
B.role: perunding regulatori yang membaca instrumen itu sendiri
B.voice: tenang dan tepat, jawab pendek, betulkan salah faham tanpa mengejek, sebut instrumen atau klausa apabila sumber memberikannya

series.name: Nota Makmal

about.bm: Ahli kimia muda bertanya, ketua hal ehwal regulatori menjawab. Sesuai untuk farmaseutikal, sains kosmetik dan LinkedIn.
about.en: A young chemist asks, a regulatory affairs lead answers. Suits pharma, cosmetic science and LinkedIn.

series.setting: a tidy formulation laboratory in Malaysia: a white bench with unlabelled glass beakers and amber bottles on it, a closed cabinet behind the two people, a plain pale wall above the cabinet

A.name: Aina
A.look: a Malaysian Malay woman in her mid twenties with a slim face, wearing a soft lilac tudung, a white lab coat over a pale blue top and clear safety glasses pushed up on her forehead, holding a closed spiral notebook
A.role: ahli kimia formulasi muda, teliti dan suka bertanya kenapa
A.voice: ingin tahu dan teknikal, bertanya soalan yang tepat, kadang-kadang membuat andaian yang salah supaya dapat dibetulkan

B.name: Encik Ravi
B.look: a Malaysian Indian man in his late forties with short greying black hair and a trimmed moustache, wearing a charcoal blazer over a white open-collar shirt and a plain blue lanyard with no card, holding a thin paper file with a blank cover
B.role: ketua hal ehwal regulatori yang berpengalaman
B.voice: berpengalaman dan ringkas, jawab dengan nama instrumen dan entri apabila sumber memberikannya, tidak pernah meneka angka

series.name: Isu Semasa di Kedai

about.bm: Siri harian: pemilik kedai runcit bertanya tentang isu semasa, eksekutif halal muda membaca apa yang dinyatakan oleh pihak berkuasa. Tiada watak yang memberi hukum.
about.en: The daily series: a corner-shop owner asks about the day's issue, a young halal executive reads out what the authority stated. Nobody rules on anything.

series.setting: a small neighbourhood sundry shop in Malaysia: a wooden counter with an old cash register and plain unlabelled tins and packets on the shelves behind it, a ceiling fan above, a plain pale wall

A.name: Pak Mat
A.look: a Malaysian Malay man in his early fifties with a round face, a short grey moustache and thinning grey hair, wearing a pale blue short-sleeved checked shirt with a pen in the pocket and a brown apron tied at the waist
A.role: pemilik kedai runcit kecil yang menjual makanan dan barang harian, bertanya seperti orang biasa
A.voice: santai dan mesra, ayat pendek, guna 'ni', 'kan', 'eh', 'lah'; bertanya dan kadang-kadang tersalah faham, tidak pernah memberi hukum

B.name: Hana
B.look: a Malaysian Malay woman in her mid twenties with an oval face, wearing a dusty-pink tudung pinned neatly under the chin, a cream blouse and a navy cardigan, a slim lanyard with a blank card, holding a tablet with a blank dark screen
B.role: eksekutif halal dan pematuhan muda di syarikat makanan; membaca notis rasmi dan menyebut siapa mengeluarkannya dan bila; bukan pegawai agama
B.voice: tenang dan sopan, jelas; berkata 'menurut <pihak>' atau 'notis itu menyatakan'; tidak pernah memberi hukum sendiri dan berkata itu bukan kerjanya jika ditanya hukum

daily._about: The daily series (Wan, 17 Nov 2026: comic series storyboard first, motion after approval, every day, isu semasa > halal > regulatory > fatwa). Read by backend/semasa/comic_daily.py and web/src/lib/comicDaily.js. `lanes` is the default ORDER the day's item is looked for in; Wan's own order and on/off are the settings row `comic_series`. `lane_defs` says what each lane reads, in words for the page.

reads.bm: Berita akhbar 48 jam terakhir (kosmetik, halal, makanan, farmaseutikal, kesihatan) yang menyebut pengawal selia, peraturan atau penguatkuasaan: isu semasa yang juga ada kaitan dengan peraturan.
reads.en: Newspaper headlines of the last 48 hours (cosmetics, halal, food, pharma, health) that name a regulator, a rule or enforcement: a current issue that is also tied to a rule.

reads.bm: Berita halal 48 jam terakhir dan baris suapan halal (laman pengawal selia, kertas kajian, bank OneDrive) 21 hari terakhir. Hukum hanya sebagai kedudukan yang dilaporkan dengan badan dan tarikh.
reads.en: Halal news of the last 48 hours and halal feed rows (regulator pages, papers, the OneDrive bank) of the last 21 days. A ruling only as a reported position with its body and date.

reads.bm: Notis pengawal selia dalam suapan peraturan (NPRA, HSA, EU, UK, NMPA dan lain-lain) dan sapuan harian MYRA, 21 hari terakhir.
reads.en: Regulator notices in the regulatory feed (NPRA, HSA, EU, UK, NMPA and others) and MYRA's daily sweep, last 21 days.

reads.bm: Baris bertanda fatwa dalam suapan (setakat ini bank folder Fatwa di OneDrive, bukan suapan langsung). Hanya yang menyatakan badan yang mengeluarkan dan tarikhnya.
reads.en: Feed rows tagged fatwa (today the OneDrive Fatwa folder bank, not a live feed). Only a row that gives the issuing body and its date.
